Giovanni Gibertoni and Alberto Besozzi took part in **EMBC 2026**, the 48th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society, held at the Metro Toronto Convention Centre in Toronto, Canada, on 26–30 July 2026.

They presented the paper **"A Charge-Integrated Modular NIR Armband for Forearm Optical Myography"** by Giovanni Gibertoni, Alberto Besozzi and Luigi Rovati (Department of Engineering "Enzo Ferrari", University of Modena and Reggio Emilia; Giovanni Gibertoni is also with the Department of Biomedical, Metabolic and Neural Sciences of the same university).

The contribution is currently **in press**: it will be added to the [Publications](/publications.qmd) page once the proceedings record and DOI are available.
